title: 第11章 家族大比一第12章 家族大比二
content_zh:
果真是修炼无岁月！
不知不觉在碧荷居的房子中，萧天已经连续修炼了七八天了。
虽然总的时间不长，但是萧天的修为可是得到了巨大的提升。
在这几天持续的努力下，已经锻炼了五个窍穴，已经到了意舍穴。
这个穴位位于胸椎棘突旁下三寸。
现在萧天把一个穴位锻炼成海。
精血在其中翻腾如海，加之天地灵气的加持更是达到气血相济，如同阴阳相交。
神奇无比。
这也体现了，胸襟宽广这一说。
现在萧天的修为也更近了一步，达到了先天三层天初期。
虽然只是一层天，但实力的增长可是比几天前强大数十倍不止。
估计现在萧天的战力在萧家中可以排到最顶尖的一个行列了。
修为战力的迅速提升，所带来的资源消耗也是海量的。
就这短短的几天，萧天不仅把以前所积累的全部用完，甚至期间还向他父亲萧玄策要了大量修炼资源。
如果换成灵石的话估计最少也得有五百中品灵石。
看着不多，可是要知道，在南陵城像萧家这样的大家族一年的纯收入也就是五千到一万中品灵石。
所以这几天萧天的消耗的已经是接近萧家一年纯收入的十分之一了。
可想而知，越修炼到后面，所需要的资源越是不可估量。
想到这些，萧天也是犯起了嘀咕。
“功法是厉害，可这消耗也着实恐怖，怕是以后，自己会被消耗死，看来不能这么被动，我得自己赚钱！”

萧天如此想道。
“傲武大陆最赚钱的职业是炼丹师。
不对不是傲武大陆，只要是修炼世界，炼丹师肯定是最赚钱的，看来以后看能不能成为炼丹师。”
萧天思考着。
“现在修炼资源也没有了，算算时间也差不多到族里比试的时间了，不修炼了，正所谓欲速则不达，我现在先沉淀一下。”
萧天想着。
于是萧天走出修炼房间…
这一天清晨“咚～”
一声悠长的声音在萧家族内响起。
这是萧家的信号钟，每当这个钟响起，必然是关乎整个家族的大事要发生。
在听到钟声的这一刻，所有年轻弟子都摩拳擦掌。
都知道是要选出优秀弟子代表家族参加宗门选拔。
这不仅仅是荣誉问题，更是走向更广阔的世界的一个机会。
所以这一次大比将会是相当惨烈角逐战。
萧天也听到了钟声，站起来，朝着演武场走去。
事先已经通知了，时间一到，就会以钟声通知弟子到前院的演武场集合。
当萧天走到演武场时，演武场上已经到了很多年轻的家族弟子。
萧天也看到了很多熟悉的面孔。
大长老之子萧强，锻体八层天后期修为。
二长老之子萧林，锻体八层天中期修为。

五长老女儿萧婉晴，锻体八层天初期修为。
六长老儿子女儿萧明辉和萧雨柔，都是锻体境八层天初期修为。
content_en:
It really takes no time to practice!
Unknowingly, Xiao Tian had been practicing for seven or eight days in a row in Biheju's house.
Although the total time is not long, Xiao Tian's cultivation level has been greatly improved.
With continuous efforts in the past few days, five acupoints have been trained, and the Yishe point has been reached.
This acupoint is located three inches below the spinous process of the thoracic vertebrae.
Now Xiao Tian has trained an acupuncture point into a sea.
The essence and blood are churning in it like a sea, and with the blessing of the spiritual energy of heaven and earth, the energy and blood complement each other, just like the intersection of yin and yang.
It's amazing.
This also reflects the saying of being broad-minded.
Now Xiao Tian's cultivation has taken a step closer, reaching the early stage of the third level of innate heaven.
Although it is only one level, its strength has grown dozens of times more than it was a few days ago.
It is estimated that Xiao Tian's combat power can now be ranked at the top of the Xiao family.
The rapid increase in cultivation and combat power also consumes a huge amount of resources.
In just a few days, Xiao Tian not only used up everything he had accumulated before, he even asked his father Xiao Xuance for a large amount of cultivation resources.
If it were replaced by spiritual stones, it would be estimated that there would be at least 500 mid-grade spiritual stones.
It doesn't look like much, but you have to know that the annual net income of a big family like the Xiao family in Nanling City is only 5,000 to 10,000 mid-grade spiritual stones.
Therefore, Xiao Tian's consumption in the past few days has been close to one-tenth of the Xiao family's annual net income.
It is conceivable that the further you advance in cultivation, the more immeasurable resources are needed.
Thinking of this, Xiao Tian also started to mutter.
"The technique is powerful, but the consumption is really terrifying. I'm afraid that I will be consumed to death in the future. It seems that I can't be so passive. I have to make money by myself!"
Xiao Tian thought so.
“The most profitable profession in Aowu Continent is the alchemist.
No, it's not Aowu Continent. As long as it's a cultivation world, alchemists are definitely the most profitable. It seems like I'll see if I can become an alchemist in the future. "
Xiao Tian thought.
"There are no training resources now. It's almost time for the clan competition. I won't practice any more. As the saying goes, haste makes waste, so I'll settle down now."
Xiao Tian thought.
So Xiao Tian walked out of the training room...
This morning "Boom~"
A long voice sounded in the Xiao family.
This is the signal bell of the Xiao family. Whenever this bell rings, something important to the entire family must be happening.
At the moment when they heard the bell, all the young disciples were gearing up.
Everyone knows that outstanding disciples are selected to represent the family in the sect selection.
This is not just a matter of honor, but an opportunity to step into a wider world.
Therefore, this competition will be quite fierce.
Xiao Tian also heard the bell, stood up, and walked towards the martial arts field.
It has been notified in advance that when the time comes, the disciples will be notified by the sound of a bell to gather at the martial arts field in the front yard.
When Xiao Tian walked to the martial arts arena, many young family disciples were already there.
Xiao Tian also saw many familiar faces.
Xiao Qiang, the son of the great elder, has cultivated to the late eighth level of body training.
Xiao Lin, the son of the second elder, has reached the middle stage of the eighth-level body training.
Xiao Wanqing, the fifth elder's daughter, has reached the early stage of cultivating the eighth-level body.
Xiao Minghui and Xiao Yurou, the son and daughter of the Sixth Elder, are both at the early stage of the eighth-level cultivation of the Body Forging Realm.
